name: EPIC 201655720
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 10.4 solar radii and 0.89 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,891 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.89 solar masses and 10.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,009 K at its surface.
